props.label: Order
props.description: Order of process in Product Strategy (REQUIRED)

props.label: Standard Rate
props.description: The standard rate represents the typically expected production rate at this workcenter. Taking into account typical downtime, material shortages, etc. This rate is used for planning purposes, but not used for OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Ideal Rate
props.description: The Ideal Rate is used for indicating 100% run time, 100% quality what you would expect the workcenter to produce. This rate is used in OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Quoted Rate
props.description: The Quoted Rate represents the target value that you may have used for estimating or quoting this project to your customer. This can be used to evaluate how close you are between your target and actual production. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Cycle Time
props.description: Cycle time is measured in Seconds per Inventory Unit

props.label: Setup Rate
props.description: The amount of time setup takes.  This is always in terms of "Hours" .

props.label: Standard Positions
props.description: The default number of workcenter positions to use for the productStrategyProcess. (REQUIRED, DEFAULT=1)

props.label: Setup Operators
props.description: The number of operators required to setup the work center for this product.

props.label: Production Operators
props.description: The number of operators required to use the work center for production.

props.label: Active
props.description: System flag indicates whether the product strategy process is active (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = TRUE)

props.label: Finished Good
props.description: Finished Good indicates the end product (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

props.label: Use Workcenter Rates
props.description: If useWorkcenterRates is set to true, the standard, setup, ideal, and quoted rates set on the workcenter will be used. (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

props.label: Final
props.description: Internal Use Only - Keeps track of final process of strategy
